concerns.text: FR-002 requires a K‑sweep in increments of 0.1. The only implementation task (T014) uses a bisection search, which deviates from the spec and leaves FR‑002 uncovered.
SC‑005 demands that all topological predictors be derived strictly from the static adjacency structure (no circularity). No task explicitly validates or enforces this constraint.
SC‑006 requires validation of the Kuramoto implementation against an analytical solution for a ring graph. No task (e.g., a unit‑test or verification script) is defined to perform this check.
SC‑001 expects an ANOVA test with a p‑value threshold < 0.05. The regression tasks (T023a, T023b) produce coefficients and p‑values but do not include an explicit ANOVA validation step.

The contract schemas (network_metrics.schema.yaml, regression_model.schema.yaml, etc.) are listed but no task is directly tagged to verify that each schema is exercised by a validator or test suite beyond the generic validator task T009.
